name: AKER CARBON CAPTURE ASA
summary: Aker Carbon Capture AS provides products, technology, and solutions within the field of carbon capture technologies, utilization, and storage. The company's carbon capture process uses a mixture of water and organic amine solvents to absorb the CO2 that can be applied on emissions from various sources, including gas, cement, refineries, and waste-to-energy through to hydrogen and other process industries. Its products include Just Catch, Big Catch, and Offshore Just Catch, as well as mobile test units. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Lysaker, Norway. Aker Carbon Capture AS is a subsidiary of Aker Horizons Holding AS.
